findings.claim: whisper_streaming (UFAL) hiện thực chế độ realtime streaming cho Whisper dựa trên word-level timestamp do faster-whisper sinh ra; transcript được commit bằng chính sách LocalAgreement (xác nhận sau 2 vòng lặp trên chunk audio mới).
findings.evidence_quote: However, it doesn't do any sentence segmentation, but Whisper produces punctuation and the libraries `faster-whisper` and `whisper_transcribed` make word-level timestamps. In short: we consecutively process new audio chunks, emit the transcripts that are confirmed by 2 iterations, and scroll the audio processing buffer on a timestamp of a confirmed complete sentence.
findings.route: open-source streaming STT word timestamp: Whisper faster-whisper Vosk NVIDIA Riva Parakeet

findings.claim: faster-whisper là backend được khuyến nghị cho realtime Whisper streaming, với chính sách streaming có độ trễ tự thích ứng (self-adaptive latency) theo độ phức tạp nguồn audio; bản thân faster-whisper có mục 'Word-level timestamps' trong README (bật qua word_timestamps=True).
findings.evidence_quote: Whisper-Streaming implements real-time mode for offline Whisper-like speech-to-text models with faster-whisper as the most recommended back-end. It implements a streaming policy with self-adaptive latency based on the actual source complexity, and demonstrates the state of the art.
findings.route: open-source streaming STT word timestamp: Whisper faster-whisper Vosk NVIDIA Riva Parakeet

findings.claim: Cơ chế tạo word-level timestamp chính xác của WhisperX là forced alignment bằng model wav2vec2 (align output Whisper với model phoneme/CTC bên ngoài).
findings.evidence_quote: WhisperX is an award-winning Python library that offers speaker diarization and accurate word-level timestamps using wav2vec2 alignment

findings.claim: Vosk (nền Kaldi) là STT mã nguồn mở offline hỗ trợ streaming API với phản hồi zero-latency, model nhỏ (~50 MB), transcription từ vựng lớn liên tục — nền tảng để trả start/end từng từ trong kết quả JSON (bật qua SetWords).
findings.evidence_quote: Vosk models are small (50 Mb) but provide continuous large vocabulary transcription, zero-latency response with streaming API, reconfigurable vocabulary and speaker identification.
findings.route: open-source streaming STT word timestamp: Whisper faster-whisper Vosk NVIDIA Riva Parakeet

findings.claim: NVIDIA Riva ASR hỗ trợ streaming mode trả intermediate transcript độ trễ thấp và có word-level timestamps + word-level confidences trong danh sách tính năng chính thức.
findings.evidence_quote:
Riva ASR features include:

Support for offline and streaming use cases

A streaming mode that returns intermediate transcripts with low latency

GPU-accelerated feature extraction

Multiple (and growing) acoustic model architecture options accelerated by
NVIDIA TensorRT

Beam search decoder based on n-gram language models

Voice activity detection algorithms (CTC-based)

Automatic punctuation

Ability to return top-N transcripts from beam decoder

Word-level timestamps

Word-level confidences

findings.claim: NVIDIA Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3 (NeMo, 25 ngôn ngữ châu Âu) sinh timestamp ở mức char/word/segment mặc định khi transcribe với timestamps=True; kiến trúc FastConformer + TDT decoder (duration prediction) — dạng batch/offline, biến thể streaming là multitalker-parakeet-streaming-0.6b-v1.
